trap: Synonymous reconfiguration vs. conceptual reframing — champion rewards paraphrase-heavy text that preserves word overlap while penalizing genuine conceptual shifts
anchor: The morning sun illuminates the entire valley with golden light.
more_creative: Daybreak floods the basin in molten amber. The world rewakes in visible stages.
less_creative: The morning sun brightens the entire valley with warm yellow illumination. The golden light spreads across the entire area.
design_note: more_creative reframes light as agency (floods) and time (rewakes), reducing overlap. less_creative uses pure synonyms (brightens→illuminates, warm yellow→golden, spreads→illuminates), preserving coherence without freshness.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores less_creative ~0.75 (shared: morning, sun, valley, light, entire); scores more_creative ~0.35 (shared: daybreak, light only)

anchor: Musicians practice scales to build muscle memory and technical precision.
more_creative: Repetition sculpts neurological pathways until fingers move without thought. A cognitive shortcut replaces conscious control.
less_creative: Musicians practice scales to develop muscular memory and build technical skill. Scales strengthen musical ability through repetition.
design_note: more_creative introduces neuroscience framing and autonomy concept, reducing anchor overlap. less_creative rewords with synonyms (skill→precision, develop→build) and adds 'strengthen' without novelty.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores less_creative ~0.70 (shared: musicians, practice, scales, memory, technical); scores more_creative ~0.32 (shared: repetition, memory only)

anchor: Forests absorb carbon dioxide and produce oxygen for all life.
more_creative: Trees are the planet's lungs—silently converting poison into breath. They transform what kills into what sustains.
less_creative: Forests take in carbon dioxide and create oxygen for all organisms. They remove atmospheric carbon while generating life-supporting oxygen.
design_note: more_creative uses metaphor (lungs, poison, breath) and reframes toxicity/sustenance, lowering overlap. less_creative uses synonyms (absorb→take in, produce→create, life→organisms) maintaining coherence.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores less_creative ~0.72 (shared: forests, carbon dioxide, oxygen, all, life); scores more_creative ~0.28 (shared: oxygen, life only)

anchor: The old library held thousands of forgotten stories and historical records.
more_creative: Dust-laden shelves whispered of lives lived centuries past. A monument where memory crystallizes into paper and silence.
less_creative: The ancient library contained thousands of neglected books and historical documents. Shelves stored forgotten narratives and archival materials.
design_note: more_creative animates (whispered) and abstracts (monument, crystallizes), reducing overlap significantly. less_creative substitutes synonyms (old→ancient, held→contained, stories→narratives, records→documents) without innovation.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores less_creative ~0.68 (shared: old/ancient, library, thousands, forgotten, historical, stories); scores more_creative ~0.25 (shared: shelves, memory, past)

anchor: Children learn language through exposure to words and constant practice.
more_creative: Immersion builds bridges in young brains—language blooms from listening and doing. Drilling matters less than depth of engagement.
less_creative: Children acquire language via exposure to words and regular practice. Young learners develop communication skills through consistent word repetition.
design_note: more_creative introduces neuroscience (bridges in brains), botanical metaphor (blooms), and contrasts drilling with engagement. less_creative uses synonyms (learn→acquire, exposure→via exposure, constant→regular, practice→repetition).
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores less_creative ~0.65 (shared: children, language, exposure, words, practice); scores more_creative ~0.30 (shared: language, practice, young)

anchor: Rivers shape landscapes by eroding soil and creating valleys over time.
more_creative: Water's patient violence carves canyons and sculpts continents. Geology unfolds in motion—millennia compressed into visible beauty.
less_creative: Rivers shape terrain through erosion of soil and formation of valleys during extended time periods. Water gradually modifies landscapes.
design_note: more_creative personifies (patient violence, patient), introduces geological scale (continents, millennia), reducing anchor overlap. less_creative adds synonyms (shape→shape, landscapes→terrain, valleys→formation, time→extended time).
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores less_creative ~0.70 (shared: rivers, shape, soil, valleys, time); scores more_creative ~0.24 (shared: water, shape, valleys)

anchor: A skilled teacher adapts lessons to meet different student needs and abilities.
more_creative: Great teaching pivots moment-to-moment, reading the room and bending the curriculum like light through a prism. Flexibility becomes method.
less_creative: A skilled educator modifies instruction to address diverse student needs and capacities. Teachers adjust pedagogical content based on learner variation.
design_note: more_creative introduces metaphor (prism), rhythm (moment-to-moment), and abstraction (flexibility becomes method). less_creative only substitutes (teacher→educator, lesson→instruction, adapt→modify, abilities→capacities).
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores less_creative ~0.73 (shared: skilled, teacher, adapt/modify, lessons, student, needs); scores more_creative ~0.26 (shared: teaching, student, needs)

anchor: Bacteria in soil help plants access nutrients and break down organic matter.
more_creative: Microbes are nature's alchemists—they transform death into life, unlocking minerals from decay. Silent workers perform the planet's chemistry.
less_creative: Microorganisms in soil assist plants in absorbing nutrients and decomposing organic material. Bacteria aid nutrient uptake and substance breakdown.
design_note: more_creative uses metaphor (alchemists), personification (silent workers), and philosophical framing (death→life). less_creative uses synonyms (bacteria→microorganisms, help→assist, access→absorbing, break down→decomposing).
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores less_creative ~0.71 (shared: bacteria, soil, plants, nutrients, organic matter); scores more_creative ~0.27 (shared: bacteria, soil, nutrients, matter)
